'''Erra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]] and was the daughter of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]] and the mother of [[Wilena]]. She was killed during the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galactic conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
